title: gpt-5-pro and o3-pro shut down on 2026-12-11 (Responses API)
summary: On 2026-12-11 OpenAI shuts down gpt-5-pro (2025-10-06) and o3-pro (2025-06-10), plus fine-tunes of these models. Both run only on the Responses API, so this advisory covers calls to POST /v1/responses that send one of these exact model names (or their dated snapshots); they fail from then on. openai-gpt-5-o3-shutdown-2026-12-11-responses covers gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano and o3.
migrationNote: Switch both to gpt-5.6-sol with reasoning.mode: pro, the replacement OpenAI's deprecations page names. That adds a request setting as well as changing the model name, so SHAPI offers no automatic swap. Re-run fine-tunes on a supported base model.
